_comment: APPROXIMATE per-MILLION-token USD prices. EDIT to match current published rates. est_cost_usd is 'API-equivalent' only; subscription (Claude Code Max/Pro) is NOT billed per token. cache_read and cache_write priced relative to input.
_rates_note: Verified 2026-07-10 vs Anthropic published rates (claude-api reference). Fable 5 / Mythos 5 10/50; Opus 4.8/4.7/4.6 5/25; Sonnet 5 3/15 sticker with a date-aware intro window 2/10 through 2026-08-31 (encoded under 'effective'; see ingest.price_for at=); Sonnet 4.6 3/15; Haiku 4.5 1/5. cache_read=0.1x input (90% off), cache_write=1.25x input. 1M context is flat-rate (no surcharge), so [1m] needs no special row. Keys are substring-prefix matched against the model id (see ingest.price_for), so a bare 'claude-sonnet-4' key does NOT match 'claude-sonnet-5' — new families need their own row or they fall to default. OpenAI GPT-5.6 (confirmed 2026-07-10 vs developers.openai.com/api/docs/pricing): Sol 5/30, Terra 2.5/15, Luna 1/6, cached_input=0.1x input; bare 'gpt-5.6' priced as Terra (Codex default tier); legacy gpt-5.5 5/30. GPT tier keys are ordered BEFORE the generic 'gpt-5.6' so first-match resolves the tier. OpenAI has no cache-write premium and the Codex ingester never sets cache_creation, so cache_write on gpt rows just mirrors input (unused).
